data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow: click Restaurants, type a destination and pick the suggestion, then apply a cuisine or feature filter, with the right parameters. It adds an unneeded "open a restaurant" step and an extra "restaurant to open" parameter, and it describes filter selection as checkboxes and a "Show more" click where the true workflow clicks a label, so a browser automation could be built from it but would be a little off.
